official_evidence.observation: Official downloads page states export files are CC BY 2.0 FR, defines sentence fields as sentence ID, language code and text, and defines reciprocal translation-link fields.
Official terms describe Tatoeba as a non-profit open sentence/translation collection and warn that translation validity and accuracy are not guaranteed by professional review.
Official export index observed 2026-10-12; the listed weekly snapshot was dated 2026-10-10.
Official index exposes English sentence data plus English-French and English-Spanish direct-link files.
Official index exposes French sentence data and a French-Spanish direct-link file.
Official index exposes Spanish sentence data.

decision_basis: The source is publicly downloadable, has an explicit reuse license, stable numeric sentence IDs and direct pairwise links sufficient to construct closed English-French-Spanish triangles. It is distinct in collection style from the already exposed news, encyclopedic and medical-development domains.
limits: Weekly URLs are mutable; exact byte hashes remain pending until download.
Crowd translations are noisy and not professionally guaranteed.
Direct triangle closure is an alignment claim supplied by Tatoeba contributors, not an independent semantic-quality judgment.
No broad benchmark or legal conclusion is claimed.
next_action: Acquire and hash only the six frozen files, construct the result-blind 1024-row closed-triangle manifest, run contamination checks, freeze its hashes, and only then score Classical, hybrid and hybrid-window once.
